snippet.title: Davy X Jones - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Enjoy the newest trailer for Davy X Jones, a new first-person action-adventure game where you play as the infamous pirate Davy Jones. The catch? You're headless, and you'll wield that severed skull – along with plenty of weapons – as you seek your revenge against Blackbeard. Davy x Jones is coming to PC and consoles. It'll launch into Steam Early Access on August 28 and be on sale for $6.66 for the first 6 days, 6 hours, and 6 minutes. 

Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2611170/DAVY_x_JONES/
